Editorial · Magazine design

Giving fashion a rhythm on the page.

A fashion magazine exploration balancing photography, expressive headlines, and a three-column grid.

RolePublication & layout design
ScopeCover, grid, typography, editorial spreads
ContextEditorial project

The approach

A grid with room for expression

The magazine uses a three-column grid as the primary organizing structure. Within it, larger photographs, headlines, and smaller reading blocks create different levels of visual emphasis.

The spreads

Pacing a visual story

The sequence moves between image-led layouts and denser editorial pages. The project explores how alignment, scale, and color can hold varied fashion content together.

Outcome

What the work brings together.

A magazine cover and collection of editorial spreads demonstrating grid-based layout and visual hierarchy.
